lines.lyric_hangul: 내 삶은 밑바닥 낭떠러지 어두운 터널 속을 걷고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: My life was rock bottom, an edge of a cliff / I’m walking in a dark tunnel

lines.lyric_hangul: 내게 잔인하고 두려운 하루를 홀로 버티고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: Cruel and fearful days / I’m enduring through alone

lines.lyric: Meoreojyeo ganeun gyoshilbokdo nasseon gil wie jijirido
lines.lyric_hangul: 멀어져 가는 교실복도 낯선 길 위에 지지리도
lines.lyric_translation: The classroom hallways get farther away, I’m on unfamiliar paths

lines.lyric_hangul: 복도 없지 내가 맞는 길을 가는가에 답 할 지도도
lines.lyric_translation: I’m so unlucky / On this path I’m on

parts.lyric: Naega matneun gireul ganeungae dab hal jidodo

lines.lyric_hangul: 하나 없이 위로 가는 길은 절대 다신 뒤로
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t even have a map / But I never want to turn around

parts.lyric: Wiro ganeun gireun jeoldae dashin dwiro gagi

lines.lyric_hangul: 가기 싫은 막막한 미로야 피눈물 대신 피땀 흘리며 나를 위로해
lines.lyric_translation: It’s a maze / Shedding blood sweat instead of blood tears, I comfort myself

parts.lyric: Pinunmul daeshin pittam heullimyeo nareul wirohae

lines.lyric_hangul: 사람들은 내게 말해 그 정도의 고비는 지나가는 소나기라고
lines.lyric_translation: People tell me this kind of suffering / Is just a passing storm

parts.lyric: Saramdeureun naege malhae geu jeongdoye gobineun

lines.lyric_hangul: 성공을 낚으려면 두려워도 실패라는 덫을 깔라고
lines.lyric_translation: That if I want to succeed, even though I’m afraid / I need to set up a trap called failure

lines.lyric: Geurae naneun gotongiran mikkireul deobseok munchae
lines.lyric_hangul: 그래 나는 고통이란 미끼를 덥석 문채
lines.lyric_translation: As I bit on the bait that is pain

lines.lyric_hangul: 방황하는 거야 지친 열정의 날개를 잠시 접어둔 채
lines.lyric_translation: I’m wandering / As I put away my tired wings of passion

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 삶은 밑바닥 낭떠러지 어두운 터널 속을 걷고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: My life was rock bottom, an edge of a cliff / I’m walking in a dark tunnel

lines.lyric_hangul: 내게 잔인하고 두려운 하루를 홀로 버티고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: Cruel and fearful days / I’m enduring through alone

lines.lyric_hangul: 손을 내밀어도 날 잡아줄 사람은 아무도 없어
lines.lyric_translation: I hold out my hand / But no one is there to grab it

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 아픔 내 눈물을 타고 위로 빠져나가고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: I’m riding on my pain and my tears / As I try to escape above

parts.lyric: Nae apeum nae nunmureul tago wiro

lines.lyric_hangul: 아무것도 없어 날 위한 손길은 걱정 하나 없이 차가운 말들뿐
lines.lyric_translation: There’s nothing / No one to care or worry about me / Only cold words

lines.lyric_hangul: 엉터리 꿈은 좀 접어
lines.lyric_translation: Telling me to give up on my dreams

lines.lyric_hangul: 포기란 말들이 내 귀를 때려가며 절망감만 커져가
lines.lyric_translation: Those quitting words keep hitting my ear / Only despair grows

lines.lyric: Himangiran haneureul jubyeon sarame soneuro garinda
lines.lyric_hangul: 희망이란 하늘을 주변 사람의 손으로 가린다
lines.lyric_translation: The hopeful sky only gets covered by other people’s hands

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 살려 기도하며 버티고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: I’m praying to live as I try to endure

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 째려보는 따가운 시선들에
lines.lyric_translation: With the piercing eyes on me

lines.lyric_hangul: 실성하지 하네 마네 잘 되어 봤자 누군가의 광대
lines.lyric_translation: I’m going insane / Even if I succeed

parts.lyric: Shilseonghaji hane mane jal dweeo bwatja

lines.lyric_hangul: 로 밖에 안 남을 넌 가수라는 직업은 집어 쳐
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll be someone’s clown / So people tell me to give up on becoming a singer

lines.lyric_hangul: 그 말을 들으며 약해져만 가는 내 자신을 밀쳐 더
lines.lyric_translation: I’m getting weak / But I keep pushing myself

lines.lyric_hangul: 찾아내 출구는 어디에
lines.lyric_translation: I’m trying to look for an exit

lines.lyric_hangul: 어둠 속에 갇혀있던 나를 끌어내
lines.lyric_translation: Take myself out from being trapped in the darkness

lines.lyric: Jom deo barakhae igoseul run away
lines.lyric_hangul: 좀 더 발악해 이곳을 run away
lines.lyric_translation: I’m fighting harder, run away from this place

lines.lyric: I’m on the hellevator nan ollagalge
lines.lyric_hangul: I'm on the Hellevator 난 올라갈게
lines.lyric_translation: I’m on the hellevator, I’m gonna go up

lines.lyric_hangul: 어두웠던 내 과거 탈출해 내 깜깜했던 앞길을 비춰
lines.lyric_translation: I’m escaping from my dark past / Shining on my path ahead

lines.lyric_hangul: 미쳐버릴 듯 지겨운 시간 잊혀져 버릴 듯 이 길을 뛰어
lines.lyric_translation: Tiresome times that drove me crazy / I’m running so I can forget

lines.lyric_hangul: 외면하던 새로운 시작의 종소리가 울리며
lines.lyric_translation: As the bell of a new start rings

lines.lyric_hangul: 나는 올라탔지 내 손을 잡고 펜트하우스로 데려다줄 my Hellevator
lines.lyric_translation: I got on, hold my hand / And take me to the penthouse, my hellevator
